title: Torch Inference
description: A Rust/actix-web multimodal model server: TTS, STT, vision, and LLM chat, all behind a shared batching/pooling/resilience core.

branches.label: Serving Core

nodes.title: Adaptive Request Batching
nodes.description: Groups concurrent requests into GPU-efficient batches with a queue-depth-adaptive timeout.

nodes.title: In-Flight Request Coalescing
nodes.description: Deduplicates identical concurrent requests so redundant work isn't repeated while one is already in progress.

nodes.title: Model & Tensor Pooling
nodes.description: Pools loaded models and pre-allocated tensors to avoid reload/allocation overhead per request.

nodes.title: Dynamic Model Registry
nodes.description: Downloads, registers, and manages ONNX/PyTorch model artifacts on demand, including auto-download on first server start.

branches.description: Request lifecycle infrastructure shared by every model endpoint.

branches.label: Multimodal Inference Services

nodes.title: Text-to-Speech Synthesis
nodes.description: Serves speech synthesis across six interchangeable engines (Kokoro-ONNX primary, plus Bark/XTTS/StyleTTS2/Piper/VITS).

nodes.title: Speech-to-Text Transcription
nodes.description: Transcribes audio via a Whisper ONNX encoder/decoder pipeline.

nodes.title: Image Classification & Detection
nodes.description: Runs ONNX image classification (EfficientNet-Lite4) and YOLOv8 object detection with NMS.

nodes.title: LLM Chat Completion
nodes.description: Proxies to a separate microservice offering an OpenAI-compatible streaming chat endpoint over an HRM-Text engine or SmolVLM-256M vision model.

nodes.title: Agentic Tool-Use Layer
nodes.description: A planner/executor loop lets the LLM call tools (HTTP fetch, TTS, STT, classify, detect, vision, reflection) — the newest, least-mature subsystem in the repo.

branches.description: The actual model-serving endpoints exposed over HTTP.

nodes.title: Circuit Breakers & Backpressure
nodes.description: Per-model circuit breakers, bulkheads, and token-bucket rate limiting protect backend model calls.

nodes.title: Request Security & Auth
nodes.description: Input sanitization/validation, auth middleware, and security middleware guard the API surface.

nodes.title: Observability
nodes.description: Structured logging, Prometheus metrics, and correlation-ID middleware instrument every request.

branches.label: Web Playground

nodes.title: React Dashboard & Consolidated Panels
nodes.description: A React frontend with dashboard, chat, TTS, STT, classify, and detect views, log viewing, and a health indicator wired to the backend.

nodes.title: Frontend Resource Hygiene
nodes.description: Blob URLs (image previews, chat TTS audio) are properly revoked and SSE chat streams stop updating after tab-switch unmount.

branches.description: Browser-based control surface for the server.
